title: Wi-Fi Connection Lost
shortDescription: Sensi thermostat cannot reach Wi-Fi network or Emerson cloud.
fullDescription: The Sensi app shows the thermostat as offline and remote control fails. Local heating/cooling still works because the schedule is stored on the device, but firmware updates and remote adjustments are blocked.

causes.cause: 2.4 GHz band disabled on dual-band router

fixSteps.title: Confirm 2.4 GHz
fixSteps.instruction: Sensi requires 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi. Split SSIDs on a dual-band router.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair thermostat
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Menu until Wi-Fi reset, then re-add device in Sensi app.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Battery Low Warning
fullDescription: Sensi ST55/ST75 use AA batteries when no C-wire is connected. Below threshold the screen dims and Wi-Fi disconnects to conserve power.

fixSteps.title: Replace AAs
fixSteps.instruction: Use fresh alkaline AA batteries. Do not mix old/new.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: No Common Wire Detected
shortDescription: Setup wizard reports missing C-wire for continuous power.
fullDescription: Sensi Touch (ST75) requires a C-wire. Classic Sensi (ST55) can run on batteries but loses Wi-Fi when batteries are low.

causes.cause: C-wire not connected at thermostat or air handler

fixSteps.title: Check air handler
fixSteps.instruction: Locate spare conductor in cable, land on C terminals at both ends.

fixSteps.title: Use add-a-wire kit
fixSteps.instruction: If no spare, install Sensi Common Wire Adapter or 24V transformer.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.
safetyWarning: Turn off furnace power at breaker before wiring.

title: Internal Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Onboard temperature sensor reading out of range.
fullDescription: Indicates the internal thermistor failed self-test. Thermostat will display E1 and refuse to control HVAC until cleared.

fixSteps.title: Reset thermostat
fixSteps.instruction: Pull from base for 30 seconds, reseat.

fixSteps.title: Warranty replacement
fixSteps.instruction: Contact Emerson if E1 returns; 5-year warranty.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Heat Not Energizing
shortDescription: W terminal not pulling 24V despite call for heat.
fullDescription: Thermostat shows heating active but furnace does not respond. Likely wiring or relay-side issue.

causes.cause: W wire loose at furnace board

fixSteps.title: Check W terminal
fixSteps.instruction: Tighten W at thermostat and furnace control board.

fixSteps.title: Check 3A fuse
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect ATO blade fuse on furnace control board.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.
safetyWarning: Power off furnace at switch before opening.

title: Cooling Not Engaging
shortDescription: Y terminal energized but compressor doesn't start.
fullDescription: Sensi calls for cool but condenser stays off. Often a contactor or capacitor failure outside the thermostat.
symptoms: Indoor blower runs but not condenser

fixSteps.title: Check disconnect
fixSteps.instruction: Verify outdoor disconnect is engaged and breaker on.

fixSteps.title: Listen at condenser
fixSteps.instruction: Tap on contactor; if unit starts, contactor is failing.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Schedule Drift
shortDescription: Programmed schedule not running at expected times.
fullDescription: Often caused by time zone misconfiguration after Wi-Fi setup or daylight savings handling.

fixSteps.title: Verify time zone
fixSteps.instruction: App > Settings > Time Zone — match your location.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Geofencing Inactive
shortDescription: Sensi not auto-switching modes based on phone location.
fullDescription: Geofencing requires Always-Allow location permission and at least one user with the feature enabled.
whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: O/B Reversing Valve Wrong
shortDescription: Heat pump runs cool when calling heat or vice versa.
fullDescription: O/B terminal configured wrong in setup. Most heat pumps use O (Trane uses B). Sensi defaults to O.

fixSteps.title: Reverse O/B in app
fixSteps.instruction: Sensi app > Settings > Equipment > Reversing Valve.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Auxiliary Heat Stuck On
fullDescription: Heat pump aux heat should only run when outdoor is too cold or thermostat is in EM HEAT. If always on, balance point or staging is misconfigured.

fixSteps.title: Set lockout temperature
fixSteps.instruction: Sensi app > Heat Pump > Aux Lockout = 35-40°F.

whenToCallPro: When in doubt, call a pro.

title: Aux Heat Locked Out
fullDescription: Sensi indicates auxiliary heat is being prevented because outdoor temp is above the lockout setting.
safetyWarning: Always disconnect power at the breaker before opening any HVAC equipment. High-voltage circuits and refrigerant systems can cause serious injury.
whenToCallPro: If unsure, ask installer to set proper lockout.

title: App Connection Lost
fullDescription: App-Connection-Lost reports the Sensi app cannot reach the thermostat through cloud or local discovery.
safetyWarning: Always disconnect power at the breaker before opening any HVAC equipment. High-voltage circuits and refrigerant systems can cause serious injury.

title: Air Filter Reminder
fullDescription: Sensi reminds users when the runtime-based filter timer expires.
safetyWarning: Always disconnect power at the breaker before opening any HVAC equipment. High-voltage circuits and refrigerant systems can cause serious injury.

title: Frost Protection Active
shortDescription: Frost protection engaged due to low temp.
fullDescription: Frost-Protect activates if indoor temp drops below safe threshold (default 40°F) and forces heat on regardless of mode.
safetyWarning: Always disconnect power at the breaker before opening any HVAC equipment. High-voltage circuits and refrigerant systems can cause serious injury.
whenToCallPro: Furnace failure in winter is urgent - call a pro.

title: Heat Cool Mode Bouncing
shortDescription: Switching between heat and cool too fast.
fullDescription: Detects setpoints that are too close, causing rapid alternation between heat and cool.
safetyWarning: Always disconnect power at the breaker before opening any HVAC equipment. High-voltage circuits and refrigerant systems can cause serious injury.

title: Setpoint Outside Range
fullDescription: Setpoint-Limit triggers when a setpoint is set outside the min/max range, often configured for landlords or vacation homes.
safetyWarning: Always disconnect power at the breaker before opening any HVAC equipment. High-voltage circuits and refrigerant systems can cause serious injury.

title: Indoor Temperature High Alert
fullDescription: Sends alert when indoor temperature rises above the configured warning threshold.
safetyWarning: Always disconnect power at the breaker before opening any HVAC equipment. High-voltage circuits and refrigerant systems can cause serious injury.
whenToCallPro: AC failures during heat waves require urgent service.

title: Indoor Temperature Low Alert
fullDescription: Alert when indoor temperature drops below user threshold, often signaling furnace issues.
safetyWarning: Always disconnect power at the breaker before opening any HVAC equipment. High-voltage circuits and refrigerant systems can cause serious injury.
whenToCallPro: Heat loss in winter risks frozen pipes - urgent.

title: Humidity Out of Range
fullDescription: Sensi humidity-aware models warn when indoor RH is too high or low for comfort and health.
safetyWarning: Always disconnect power at the breaker before opening any HVAC equipment. High-voltage circuits and refrigerant systems can cause serious injury.
whenToCallPro: Whole-home humidity solutions are best for chronic issues.

title: Wi-Fi Signal Weak
fullDescription: Sensi shows when Wi-Fi RSSI is borderline, predicting future drops.
safetyWarning: Always disconnect power at the breaker before opening any HVAC equipment. High-voltage circuits and refrigerant systems can cause serious injury.
whenToCallPro: Most fixes are router-side and not HVAC.

title: Heat Pump Mode Misconfigured
shortDescription: Heat pump mode setting does not match installed equipment.
fullDescription: Sensi Heat-Pump-Mode indicates the thermostat is set to heat pump but the wiring or O/B does not align.

faq.a: Yes — different homes have different equipment.

title: Wi-Fi Onboarding Timeout
shortDescription: Initial Wi-Fi setup did not complete.
fullDescription: Sensi Wi-Fi-Setup-Failed indicates the SoftAP/Bluetooth onboarding flow timed out.

title: App Login Failure
shortDescription: App could not authenticate to Emerson cloud.
fullDescription: Sensi App-Login indicates an authentication failure when logging into the Sensi mobile app.

faq.a: Yes — same login on phone and tablet.

title: Schedule Has No Entries
shortDescription: Schedule is enabled but contains no setpoints.
fullDescription: Sensi Schedule-Empty indicates schedule mode is on but no time blocks are programmed.

faq.a: Use 4 setpoints per day: wake, away, return, sleep.

title: Aux Threshold Out of Range
shortDescription: Aux heat threshold is set outside reasonable bounds.
fullDescription: Sensi Aux-Threshold indicates the auxiliary heat outdoor threshold is set above 50 F or below -20 F, which is unusual.

title: Cooling Lockout Out of Range
shortDescription: Cooling lockout setpoint outside reasonable range.
fullDescription: Sensi Cool-Threshold indicates a cooling lockout is preventing AC from running in temperatures it should handle.

faq.a: Prevents AC running too cold and damaging compressor.

title: Setpoint Outside Allowed Range
shortDescription: User attempted setpoint outside thermostat min/max.
fullDescription: Sensi Setpoint-Range indicates a setpoint command was outside the allowed range (typically 45–95 F).

title: Compressor Anti-Cycle Active
shortDescription: Compressor is locked out for short-cycle protection.
fullDescription: Sensi Compressor-Lockout indicates the thermostat is enforcing the minimum off-time (5 min) before compressor restart.

title: Internal Sensor Calibration Drift
shortDescription: Internal temp sensor has drifted from calibration.
fullDescription: Sensi Sensor-Drift indicates the internal sensor reading no longer matches expected accuracy.

title: Firmware Update Failed
shortDescription: Over-the-air firmware update did not complete.
fullDescription: Sensi Firmware-Update indicates an OTA firmware update could not finish — usually a Wi-Fi drop mid-update.
